Always check the verse before you trust the plot twist, friend.

explanations.answer: A dove that nests at the mouth of a cave

explanations.explanation: Envy and praise would be a happy ending, but the verse isn't happy. It says, “Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him.” (Jeremiah 48:39). Those around him are looking on with ridicule and horror, not praise.
